1926, June
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 1.
Page 31 Cont.
June 5th Consumption Is it Hopeless? Francis 0'Neill 10 of 121 Hall Av. Windsor, doctoring now 7 years for tuberculosis, wants to be a Jesuite if able. To-day enrolled for year.
June 6th St. Vitus Dance 2nd Atack. Cathleen Teats 11 5044 Alendale Enrolled about a year ago perpetually for very severe Atac
8th 7 Years Blind. Victor F. Mitty 41 - 706 Mt. Clair Blind & nerveous Enrolls perpetually To-day after doctoring 7 yrs for eyes. - No difference now in night & day.
Page 32
June 25 th Born Blind Double Cataract case in 5000 to hope says Specialist. Robert LeBeault 5 from Lake Lindin, Mich .; about to be brought to Ann Arbor for Specialist examination - after others dis- couraging decisions - is enrolled To-day for 2 years, mother deciding to wait a week before going to said Specialist. Oct. 18 Same Robert reported as seeing perfectly - both cataracts removed perfectly. Deo Gr.
Dec. 6 Boy's aunt reports To-day that boys sight is perfect - going to school regularly. 9 July 2 yrs later enrolled perpetually - beautiful eyes. August 17, 1934 called on way home from Chicago; now 13 OK
July 7th Cancer Cured. Mrs. Bertha Smith 59 239 McDougall of Windsor, Examined for cancer of stomach, both in Windsor Hospital and four times on the operation - table at H. Ford's is enrolled three week ago June 17 in S.M.A. and is declared entirely cured July 2nd without actually having any operation. P.S. Found cured at said 4th Examination in Fords
13th Epylepsy Improving. William G. Tunis, 12 (140 lbs) 12467 Barlow Ave. Enrolled July 3rd for year as against eplifits comes with parents To-day to Monastery quite improved.
July 21st Enemic Cured Mrs. Sarah Barker 32, N.Cath of 633 LeMay Enrolled May 31 as against pernicious Enemia. not able to walk at the time, comes To-day without difficulty. Deo Gr!
